The '''Gowix Corp superstructure''' was a building owned by [[Gowix Corporation]] in the [[Axial Park]] district's [[Archival Square]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. The building was thousands of [[Meter/Legends|meters]] high,<ref name="Firestorm" /> and in [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR dates|4}}</ref> during the [[Battle of Corellia]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and Imperial forces seized control of the building. Those forces installed a weapon known as the [[Firestorm Turbolaser]] in the upper floors of the Gowix Corporation building as well as [[Korvalus Tower|two other]] [[Tyrelli Habitat|buildings]] as part of Operation Firestorm&mdash;a Sith plot designed by the fallen [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tol Braga]] to inflict heavy casualties in Axial Park with the [[Turbolaser/Legends|Turbolasers]]. However, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] flew an [[Imperial assault shuttle|assault shuttle]] to one of the building's landing pads and infiltrated the building, eliminating the Imperials and Sith within before destroying the Turbolaser.<ref name="Firestorm" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gowix Corp superstructure first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]], as a class-restricted phase for the Jedi Knight class mission "Firestorm."
